projects.title: Neural Vision AI
projects.description: A cutting-edge computer vision dashboard that processes real-time video streams for object detection. Built with WebRTC, Vue 3, and WebGL for rendering bounding boxes.

projects.title: Crypto Pulse
projects.description: Real-time cryptocurrency tracking SPA. Features glassmorphism UI, WebSocket integrations for live ticker data, and interactive TradingView charts.

projects.title: SynthWave Editor
projects.description: An entirely browser-based code editor styled with retro-futuristic aesthetics. Features syntax highlighting, local file system access API, and vim bindings.

projects.title: AutoML Pipeline UI
projects.description: Frontend interface for an automated machine learning platform. Allows users to drag-and-drop datasets and configure training hyperparameters visually.
